title: Storage Rental Payments and the Storage Balance
content:
Storage payments reduce the storage balance of a Storage Rental and are applied to the oldest open charge first.

## The storage balance

The storage balance is what the leaseholder owes on the Storage Rental: storage rent and storage fees, less credits and payments. Rent and fees increase it; credits and payments reduce it.

## Acceptance

Storage payments are accepted while the rental is active, overlocked, notice given or vacated. The status that counts is the rental's status in the system record for that rental.

| Rental status | Storage payment accepted |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Overlocked | Yes |
| Notice given | Yes |
| Vacated | Yes |
| Reserved | No |
| Cancelled | No |

## Application

A payment is applied to the oldest open storage charge first. Payment by application of the security deposit is used only at final accounting.

Each payment on a Storage Rental is recorded with the date received, the amount, the instrument used and its confirmation or instrument number.

## Worked application (hypothetical Storage Rental ledger)

Open charges: rent of $55.00 posted on the 1st of the month, and a $20.00 access card fee posted on the 15th. A payment of $60.00 is received.

| Order | Open charge | Applied | Left open |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Rent posted on the 1st, $55.00 | $55.00 | $0.00 |
| 2 | Access card fee posted on the 15th, $20.00 | $5.00 | $15.00 |

The storage balance after the payment is $15.00.

## Basis questions

**Can a former resident whose Storage Rental is vacated still pay the storage balance?** Yes. Payments are accepted while the rental is vacated.

**Can the security deposit be applied to the storage balance during the rental?** No. Application of the security deposit is used only at final accounting.

**Which charge does a partial payment reduce first?** The oldest open storage charge.
